preconditions: Select CLI tips, auto, direct advice or report saving; tips forces discovery while auto can use cached entries.
Resolve authorized project/host metadata, discovery targets and output audience before the audit.
Inspect llm_backends effects for inherited registry writes; source hashes in this sidecar do not bind that dependency.

expected_effects.effect: tips refreshes discovery; auto/gather refresh when no cached backend entries exist.
expected_effects.scope: Discovery endpoints, host hardware utilities and the llm_backends registry in the toolkit checkout.
expected_effects.basis: cli tips calls advise(fresh=True); gather otherwise uses registry.load() or registry.refresh(scan_subnet=...).
expected_effects.impact: An audit can produce network probes and a shared registry overwrite. A subnet flag on the cached auto path does not itself force a refresh.
expected_effects.verification: Run gather against empty and populated temporary registries with mocked discovery; verify writes and explicit fresh behavior.

expected_effects.effect: auto_audit reads project directives/source and host/runtime metadata, returning scores, findings and recommendations.
expected_effects.scope: Selected project, local skill catalog, host prefix sources, MCP configuration and caller output.
expected_effects.basis: auto_audit assembles directives, duplication_scan, local catalog and profile_host; gather reports configured cloud-key names, not key values.
expected_effects.impact: Consumes CPU/I/O and may expose paths, snippets and infrastructure information. Some sub-audits return errors or unavailable sections instead of complete findings.
expected_effects.verification: Use an isolated project and mock external discovery; inspect missing/error sections and ensure suggested deeper-pass commands are not executed.

expected_effects.effect: auto --save persists Markdown/HTML reports under the audited project.
expected_effects.scope: The selected project .botte/reports directory and output consumers.
expected_effects.basis: cli calls report.save for the auto save path using rep[project].
expected_effects.impact: Retains project and host facts beyond the audit and consumes storage; a report is a snapshot of one environment.
expected_effects.verification: Save fixture output into a temporary project; inspect paths and contents.

expected_effects.effect: recommend and budget_recommender return heuristic hardware/software changes.
expected_effects.scope: Caller decisions and stdout; recommendations themselves do not install or purchase anything.
expected_effects.basis: advisor.recommend and budget_recommender.recommend use local rules/tables.
expected_effects.impact: Can guide exploration but do not verify current prices, model compatibility or target workload savings.
expected_effects.verification: Compare recommendations to supplied fixture inputs; obtain target measurements before claiming savings or making a purchase.

expected_effects.effect: Inside an explicitly enabled observation session, expose instrumented call boundaries and any supported write samples to a separate partial evidence report.
expected_effects.scope: Current synchronous call context, current effects declaration and configured checkpoint/report destinations; no file contents or endpoint arguments are added by the observer.
expected_effects.basis: Operation decorators and write contexts use skills.capabilities.observations, an imported dependency not bound by these local hashes. Registry and LRU write hooks reference existing effect indices without claiming to validate the entire effect.
expected_effects.impact: Makes direct and inherited consequences traceable; adds bounded reads and optional checkpoint writes and can disclose paths, fingerprints and declarations.
expected_effects.verification: Run the isolated observation fixtures in skills/conductor/test_observations.py; check inactive mode, nested parents, cache hits and partial writes, and leave uninstrumented effects unassessed.

downstream_effects.effect: A cache-miss audit changes backend availability seen by later routing, cluster or checkup calls.
downstream_effects.scope: Other consumers of the llm_backends registry.
downstream_effects.basis: The dependency refresh replaces shared discovery state, including empty results.
downstream_effects.impact: A seemingly observational parent can alter later decisions or induce another discovery.
downstream_effects.verification: Replay the parent audit with an empty registry and inspect the saved entries and a subsequent consumer read.

downstream_effects.effect: A consumer may act on recommendations or publish a retained report.
downstream_effects.scope: Target configuration, budget decisions and report recipients.
downstream_effects.basis: The audit returns advice and deeper-pass commands as data; execution/sharing is controlled by the caller.
downstream_effects.impact: Stale assumptions or missing analysis can propagate into changes; output can disclose project or host metadata.
downstream_effects.verification: Verify the concrete target context, unavailable sections and destination before applying or sharing advice.

reversibility.strategy: Review saved reports separately from inherited registry changes. Restore an appropriate retained registry snapshot only after accounting for later writes; recommendations require no code rollback unless acted upon.
residual_effects: Network probes and disclosed report copies cannot be recalled by the audit.
Downstream configuration or purchases need their own recovery process.

retry.check_before_retry: Check whether the previous audit refreshed shared metadata or wrote a report. Repetition may change the snapshot and duplicate retained output; inspect sub-audit errors separately.
retry.stop_condition: Stop repeated refresh/save attempts on unresolved scope or persistence errors. Do not infer permission to run the suggested deeper passes from the report.

required_scope: Current task authority to inspect project/host metadata, contact the resolved discovery targets, and retain/share reports at the selected destination. Advice grants no configuration, purchase or execution authority.

analysis.summary: Infrastructure advice is mostly analysis, with inherited discovery writes and optional report persistence. Its scores and savings are contextual heuristics; partial results remain explicitly limited.
uncertainties: llm_backends, directives_audit, context_profiler, skill_finder and report are outside these local source bindings.
Unavailable sub-audits and cached metadata can limit the result without a total command failure.
Hardware price and workload-performance estimates are not current measurements.
Optional observation reports cover instrumented synchronous calls and selected writes only; uninstrumented, concurrent, remote or background effects remain unverified.

reuse.target: Compare infrastructure options for a named project and workload.
reuse.rationale: The report relates observed hardware/configuration to candidate changes and preserves reasons.
adaptations: Separate measured target facts from cached state and heuristic savings.
Account for dependency writes and review the exact cost/quality criteria before action.
reuse.validation: Replay cache-hit/cache-miss fixtures, then compare a candidate against target workload measurements without treating the score as proof.
